name: artistic
label: Artistic
css: .style-artistic { background: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); font-family: 'Limelight', serif; position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 32px; min-height: 1080px; min-width: 1080px; box-sizing: border-box; } .style-artistic::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 40%); opacity: 0.08; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; } .style-artistic > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .style-artistic .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; padding-top: 24px; word-wrap: break-word; max-width: 95%; } .style-artistic .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; word-wrap: break-word; max-width: 90%; } .style-artistic .step { position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 32px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); opacity: 0.12; line-height: 1; margin: 0; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .style-artistic .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); margin: 0; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .slide-code.style-artistic { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1F2937 0%, #111827 100%); } .slide-code.style-artistic .hook { color: #FFFFFF; text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); } .slide-code.style-artistic .text { color: #E5E7EB; } .slide-code.style-artistic .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); opacity: 0.25; } .slide-code.style-artistic .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); } .slide-code.style-artistic::before { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-artistic { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0F172A 0%, #1E293B 100%); } .slide-insight.style-artistic .hook { color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-insight.style-artistic .insight-text { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: #FFFFFF; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0; word-wrap: break-word; max-width: 90%; text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); } .slide-insight.style-artistic .text { color: #CBD5E1; } .slide-insight.style-artistic .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); opacity: 0.3; } .slide-insight.style-artistic .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); } .slide-insight.style-artistic::before { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, #8B5CF6 50%, transparent 100%); opacity: 0.2; }
